title: 2. Lok Sabha – House of the People

blocks.content:
Lok Sabha is the lower house and represents the people of India.
Composition:
• Maximum strength – 552 members
• Present strength – 543 elected members
• Members are directly elected by the people.

Tenure:
• Normal term – 5 years
• Can be dissolved earlier by the President.
Lok Sabha is the lower house and represents the people of India.

items: Direct election by the people is the mode of election for Lok Sabha members.
The President has the power to dissolve the Lok Sabha before the completion of its 5-year tenure.
Distinguish between Maximum Strength (552) and Present Strength (543).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Lok Sabha is the lower house representing the people of India.
The maximum strength is 552 members, with the present strength standing at 543 elected members.
All members of the Lok Sabha are directly elected by the people.
The normal term of the house is 5 years, but it can be dissolved earlier by the President.
